newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreign investors biggest yen bond buyers in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investors biggest yen bond buyers in Jan.

text.p: Foreign investors continued to be the biggest buyers of yen bonds in January, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Thursday.
Foreigners' net yen bond purchases in January totalled 2.0622 trillion yen, up from 1.3931 trillion yen in December.
The bulk of foreigners' buying, 1.6080 trillion yen worth, was in short-term bonds.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
